newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil up, gasoline stable.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil up, gasoline stable.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline was stable. Eurograde barges traded at $192 fob ARA, little changed from Monday.
Naphtha was steady too. July swaps were talked at around $180 cif NWE.
Spot gas oil prices were lead higher by stronger benchmark gas oil futures, but trade was thin with the gains dulling barge buying interest and good supplies weighing on cargo premiums.
High sulphur barges traded at $86 fob Rotterdam, or $1.50 weaker than Monday's highest deal.
They were then dealt further down at 50 cent intervals to $84 a tonne. Some traders said the lower levels were linked to a pricing game, not fundamentals.
High sulphur cargoes were quiet with the market seen weakened partly by a shut transatlantic arb.
